improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
improve.coach: It's come up in 42% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
improve.coach: Flagged 42% of the time overall, 20% in your last five. That's a trend I like.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
improve.coach: This one's been sneaking up: 60% lately vs 42% overall.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: The net said thank you, and so do I. There in 67% of your matches. Build your game around it.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed. Shows up in 42% of your matches. That's a calling card.
